issues.on_page: Local Receipts: Other - Sewer 48,801.66 + Water 59,761.72 + Sanitation 19,904.88
issues.issue: Under the user's 2026-10-28 rule, utility fund sales/charges (including sanitation) go to the category Utility Charges, not charges for services/fees. The printed label is only 'Other', so treating the line as user charges is an assumption (already marked review).
